
TextAnimator    用于播放文本动画

需要实现的功能：

1. 给定开始的码位，总帧数，生成一个文本展示实体，播放文本动画，播放完毕自动删除该实体

{
    config:{
        tags: [],
        scale: 1,
        color: 16777215,
        start: 0,
        time: 0,
    }
}

physical 带有物理效果的

平抛运动，斜抛运动，任意实体均可
方向为实体面朝的方向



{
    config: {
        v: 0,
        g: 0,
        t: 1,
        tick_cmdv: [],
        cmdv:[],
    }
}




summon minecraft:text_display ~ ~1 ~ {Tags:["TEXT"],text:'[{"type":"text","text":"1","color":"red","clickEvent":{action:"run_command",command:"tellraw @a \"114\""}}]',billboard:fixed,alignment:left}
/tellraw @a [{"type":"text","text":"1","color":"#66CCFF","clickEvent":{"action":"run_command","value":"/tellraw @a \"114\""}}]

summon minecraft:text_display ~ ~1 ~ {Tags:["TEXT"],text:'[{"type":"text","text":"1","color":"red","clickEvent":{action:"run_command",command:"say 1"}}]',billboard:fixed,alignment:left}
/tellraw @a [{"type":"text","text":"1","color":"#66CCFF","clickEvent":{"action":"run_command","value":"say 1"}}]


summon minecraft:text_display ~ ~1 ~ {Tags:["TEXT"],text:'"114"'}
